# streamline_user (Resource)

Preserves legacy `streamline_user` state so provider upgrades do not make existing state unreadable. Streamline does not expose an API for creating, reading, rotating, or deleting SASL credentials. Manage credentials outside Terraform and use `streamline_acl` for authorization. Remove legacy entries with `terraform state rm` after confirming external credential ownership.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) Legacy SASL/SCRAM username.

### Optional

- `mechanism` (String) Legacy SASL mechanism.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Legacy state identifier (same as username).
